title: Exercise Harimau Shakti VI begins in Malaysia
summary: The sixth edition of the India–Malaysia joint Army exercise is being held at Ipoh from 19 to 30 November.
body: The sixth edition of Harimau Shakti, the joint military exercise between the Indian Army and the Malaysian Army, began on 19 November at Ipoh, Malaysia, and runs until 30 November.
Exercises of this kind usually focus on counter-insurgency and jungle operations, sharing drills and building interoperability.
## Other exercises in the same fortnight

- Mitra Shakti 2026: India and Sri Lanka.
- IMNEX-26: India and Myanmar navies.
- Sahayata Setu: an IAF humanitarian assistance and disaster relief exercise at Jamnagar, 17 to 19 November.
Harimau means 'tiger' in Malay. Garuda Shakti is the exercise with Indonesia; Mitra Shakti is with Sri Lanka.
